name: Collision Detector
problem: v0.2 had a cycle-detection defect and shipped a placeholder module rather than the implementation exercised during notebook tests.
hypothesis: A path-preserving DFS cycle detector, unified direct/transitive analysis, and clean-package verification will eliminate the known defect and reduce packaging drift without granting ASCENSION authority over sibling systems.

interfaces.name: analyze_ecosystem
assumptions: manifests are syntactically valid and truthful

evidence.result: Initial regression suite failed with ModuleNotFoundError before production module existed.
Focused regression suite passed 7/7 after implementation.
Full suite passed 13/13, including 500 random graph cycle-oracle comparisons and 300 injected critical transitive collisions.
v0.2 packaged module confirmed placeholder-only; v0.2.1 corrects artifact/runtime mismatch.

acceptance_tests: detects multihop mutation collision and preserves path
regression_tests: 500 random graphs match independent cycle oracle
failure_modes: Undeclared or dishonest manifest facts remain invisible
Semantic conflicts outside the manifest vocabulary may be missed
First-path transitive evidence does not enumerate every possible path
Large dense graphs may need scaling optimizations

rollback.method: Remove optional detector package; it performs no external writes or sibling mutations.

compatibility.backward_note: v0.2.1 supersedes defective v0.2 package; no external adoption is claimed

promotion_decision: Remain CANDIDATE because Evidence Gate lacks validation against authenticated real sibling manifests.
next_experiment: Authenticated manifest/trust adapter and real multi-system contract fixtures; then feed findings into Evaluator Fabric Boundary/Non-Interference gates.
